name: OpenStax
instruction: Choose a subject and book, then inspect its contents for the requested topic.
coverage: Bundled publisher section locators; labels derived from sitemap URLs are explicitly marked.

name: NPTEL
instruction: Search the course title or discipline; open a course and locate the relevant lecture. Check language and enrollment requirements.
coverage: Bundled course-title metadata; individual lecture coverage and current availability unverified.
catalog_observation: Public catalog metadata observed on 2026-11-07; one sample course returned HTTP 200 to HEAD.

name: MIT OpenCourseWare
instruction: Search the topic, select a course and then its relevant reading or lecture. Check prerequisites.
coverage: Bundled course and section locators from selected official course sitemaps.

name: NCERT textbooks
instruction: Select the class, subject, book and language; locate the matching chapter. A portal link is not a verified chapter recommendation.
coverage: Manual textbook catalog route; individual chapters not indexed. Portal access may vary.
catalog_observation: Portal access failed in this environment on 2026-11-07; original official link retained as unverified.

name: DIKSHA
instruction: Select board, grade, subject and requested language, then search the topic. Check any sign-in requirements.
coverage: Manual curriculum and regional-language discovery route; specific items not indexed.
catalog_observation: Explore route returned HTTP 200 to HEAD on 2026-11-07; individual resources not inspected.

name: SWAYAM
instruction: Search the course catalog and check language, prerequisites, session dates and enrollment. Certificate fees and course access can differ.
coverage: Manual course catalog route; current enrollment and individual lessons not indexed.
catalog_observation: Catalog resolved in browsing on 2026-11-07; HEAD returned 405 and is unsupported, not evidence of a broken site.

name: Khan Academy
instruction: Choose the subject and course, then locate the requested topic and available language. Return for independent practice.
coverage: Starter lesson references plus manual catalog navigation.

name: PhET
instruction: Browse simulations by subject and language. Check that the simulation models the requested concept before beginning.
coverage: Starter simulation reference plus manual catalog navigation.

name: National Testing Agency
instruction: Select the relevant examination and its official current syllabus or information bulletin. Verify the examination year before mapping a resource.
coverage: Official examination discovery route; no claim of verified current JEE or NEET syllabus mappings.

name: HackerTube
instruction: Search the requested topic and inspect the original video's relevance and prerequisites.
coverage: Bundled attributed video metadata; playback and educational accuracy unverified.
